intro: I build interactive experiences, one mechanic at a time. My work focuses on Unity 2D and 3D development, game physics, custom controllers and mobile games.

projects.title: BloxStrike
projects.summary: A compact, block-styled first-person shooter built around team combat, readable arenas and weapon handling. My original implementation uses offline 5v5 matches: the player and four AI teammates face five opponents. Custom navigation, target selection and shooting connect the combat systems into a complete match.
features: Custom AI navigation, targeting and shooting
roleNotes: Built this game from scratch in Unity and C#.
Built the complete project from scratch in eight days, according to the development notes in the supplied archive.
Implemented AI bots with navigation, cover, target selection and shooting behaviours.
Prioritized the main gameplay loop rather than a separate tutorial.

projects.title: Cannon Blast Master
projects.summary: A physics-based cannon game about lining up a shot and bringing structures down. Aim, fire and knock targets apart across short stages, with obstacles that reward timing and accuracy. I built the game from scratch, including the 3D assets, with a focus on satisfying impacts and clear level objectives.
roleNotes: Built this game from scratch in Unity and C#.
Developed the entire project from scratch in one week (five working days).
